newsitem.title: MEXICO: Thieves loot Mexican church, steal gold charms.
newsitem.headline: Thieves loot Mexican church, steal gold charms.

text.p: Thieves have looted a church in western Mexico, stealing ornamental gold charms known as "miracles" from the walls and 50,000 pesos ($6,250) in cash from a safe.
The charms, weighing about one kg (2.2 pounds), had an estimated value of 80,000 pesos ($10,000), parish priest Albertano Gonzalez told the state-owned news agency Notimex.
He said the thieves entered the Virgin of San Lucas church in Michoacan state while he was out visiting families on Monday. The cash had been earmarked for church repairs, he added.
